appDescription.message: GANTIKAN SAYA — satu ayat, satu tujuan, 132 aksara atau kurang, tiada bahasa pemasaran.
appDescription.description: en: REPLACE ME — one sentence, one purpose, 132 characters or fewer, no marketing.

popupRefresh.description: en: Read the active tab again

popupCopyFailed.message: Tidak dapat menyalin — tekan Ctrl+C sebagai ganti
popupCopyFailed.description: en: Could not copy — press Ctrl+C instead

reasonGeneric.message: Sesuatu menghentikan perkara ini sebelum ia selesai. Sila cuba lagi.
reasonGeneric.description: en: Something stopped this before it finished. Please try again.

reasonBusy.description: en: This tab is already busy.

reasonRestricted.message: Halaman ini dilindungi oleh pelayar dan tidak boleh dibaca.
reasonRestricted.description: en: This page is protected by the browser and cannot be read.

reasonNoTab.description: en: No active tab was found.

reasonNoTitle.message: Halaman ini tiada tajuk untuk dibaca.
reasonNoTitle.description: en: This page has no title to read.

reasonTabClosed.message: Tab itu ditutup sebelum kerja selesai.
reasonTabClosed.description: en: That tab was closed before the work finished.

reasonNoAnswer.description: en: The extension did not answer.

reasonBrowserPage.message: Halaman pelayar seperti Tetapan, Sambungan dan halaman Tab Baharu terlarang bagi setiap sambungan. Cuba pada halaman web biasa.
reasonBrowserPage.description: en: Browser pages such as Settings, Extensions and the New Tab page are off limits to every extension. Try this on a normal web page.

reasonDevtools.description: en: DevTools windows are off limits to extensions.

reasonViewSource.message: Halaman kod sumber terlarang bagi sambungan. Cuba halaman itu sendiri.
reasonViewSource.description: en: View-source pages are off limits to extensions. Try the page itself instead.

reasonExtensionPage.message: Halaman sambungan, termasuk halaman sambungan ini sendiri, dilindungi oleh pelayar.
reasonExtensionPage.description: en: Extension pages, including this one's own, are protected by the browser.

reasonWebStore.message: Chrome Web Store menghalang sambungan daripada membaca halamannya.
reasonWebStore.description: en: The Chrome Web Store blocks extensions from reading its pages.

reasonFileUrl.message: Fail setempat memerlukan satu kebenaran tambahan. Buka halaman sambungan pelayar anda, cari sambungan ini, dan hidupkan “Benarkan akses kepada URL fail”.
reasonFileUrl.description: en: Local files need one extra permission. Open your browser’s Extensions page, find this extension, and turn on "Allow access to file URLs".

reasonPageDidNotLoad.message: Halaman ini tidak dimuatkan, jadi belum ada apa-apa untuk dibaca.
reasonPageDidNotLoad.description: en: This page did not load, so there is nothing to read yet.

reasonPdfViewer.message: Ini pemapar PDF terbina dalam pelayar. Sambungan tidak boleh membaca di dalamnya — buka PDF itu dalam tab biasa atau muat turun dahulu.
reasonPdfViewer.description: en: This is the browser’s built-in PDF viewer. Extensions cannot read inside it — open the PDF in a normal tab or download it first.

reasonSandboxed.message: Halaman ini dikurung dalam kotak pasir oleh tapak yang membukanya, jadi sambungan tidak boleh membacanya.
reasonSandboxed.description: en: This page is sandboxed by the site that opened it, so extensions cannot read it.

reasonAddonStore.message: Tapak tambahan menghalang sambungan daripada membaca halamannya.
reasonAddonStore.description: en: The add-ons site blocks extensions from reading its pages.

reasonStorageFull.message: Peranti ini kehabisan ruang, jadi tiada apa-apa yang disimpan. Padamkan beberapa baris tersimpan dalam Pilihan dan cuba lagi.
reasonStorageFull.description: en: This device is out of space, so nothing was saved. Delete some stored rows in Options and try again.

reasonTimedOut.message: Ini mengambil masa terlalu lama dan telah dihentikan. Tiada apa-apa yang tertinggal.
reasonTimedOut.description: en: This took too long and was stopped. Nothing was left behind.

reasonSettingTooBig.message: Nilai itu terlalu panjang untuk tetapan tersegerak anda. Cuba yang lebih pendek.
reasonSettingTooBig.description: en: That value is too long to store in your synced settings. Try a shorter one.

reasonSettingsWriteFailed.message: Tetapan itu tidak dapat disimpan. Tunggu sebentar dan cuba lagi.
reasonSettingsWriteFailed.description: en: That setting could not be saved. Wait a moment and try again.

optionsLead.message: Disimpan secara automatik. Jika penyegerakan pelayar anda dihidupkan, tetapan anda mengikut profil pelayar anda — ia tidak pernah dihantar kepada kami.
optionsLead.description: en: Saved automatically. If your browser’s sync is turned on, your settings travel with your browser profile — they are never sent to us.

optCopyOnOpenDesc.message: Salin hasilnya ke papan keratan sebaik sahaja tetingkap timbul dibuka.
optCopyOnOpenDesc.description: en: Copy the result to the clipboard as soon as the popup opens.

optKeepHistoryDesc.message: Dimatikan secara lalai. Apabila dihidupkan, hasil disimpan pada peranti ini sahaja, disenaraikan di bawah, dan boleh dipadam pada bila-bila masa.
optKeepHistoryDesc.description: en: Off by default. When on, results are stored on this device only, listed below, and deletable at any time.

optHistoryLimitDesc.message: Baris paling lama digugurkan sebaik sahaja senarai melebihi angka ini.
optHistoryLimitDesc.description: en: Oldest rows are dropped once the list is longer than this.

optRetentionTitle.message: Padam baris yang lebih lama daripada

optRetentionDesc.message: Hari. Baris lama dibuang secara automatik di latar belakang. Tetapkan 0 untuk menyimpan baris sehingga had sejarah menggugurkannya.
optRetentionDesc.description: en: Days. Old rows are removed automatically in the background. Set 0 to keep rows until the history limit drops them.

optThemeDesc.description: en: Follows your system by default.

dataNothingStored.message: Tiada apa-apa disimpan pada peranti ini.
dataNothingStored.description: en: Nothing is stored on this device.

dataStoredRows_zero.message: $COUNT$ baris disimpan pada peranti ini. Tiada apa-apa yang keluar dari sini.
dataStoredRows_zero.description: en: $COUNT$ rows are stored on this device. Nothing leaves it.

dataStoredRows_one.message: $COUNT$ baris disimpan pada peranti ini. Tiada apa-apa yang keluar dari sini.
dataStoredRows_one.description: en: $COUNT$ row is stored on this device. Nothing leaves it.

dataStoredRows_two.message: $COUNT$ baris disimpan pada peranti ini. Tiada apa-apa yang keluar dari sini.
dataStoredRows_two.description: en: $COUNT$ rows are stored on this device. Nothing leaves it.

dataStoredRows_few.message: $COUNT$ baris disimpan pada peranti ini. Tiada apa-apa yang keluar dari sini.
dataStoredRows_few.description: en: $COUNT$ rows are stored on this device. Nothing leaves it.

dataStoredRows_many.message: $COUNT$ baris disimpan pada peranti ini. Tiada apa-apa yang keluar dari sini.
dataStoredRows_many.description: en: $COUNT$ rows are stored on this device. Nothing leaves it.

dataStoredRows_other.message: $COUNT$ baris disimpan pada peranti ini. Tiada apa-apa yang keluar dari sini.
dataStoredRows_other.description: en: $COUNT$ rows are stored on this device. Nothing leaves it.

dataDurable.message: Kekal: pelayar telah berjanji untuk tidak memadamkannya.
dataDurable.description: en: Durable: the browser has promised not to clear this.

dataBestEffort.message: Sedaya upaya: pelayar boleh memadamkannya sendiri jika ruang peranti berkurangan. Eksport satu sandaran.
dataBestEffort.description: en: Best effort: the browser may clear this on its own if the device runs low on space. Export a backup.

dataDurabilityUnknown.message: Pelayar ini tidak menyatakan sama ada data tersimpan akan dikekalkan, jadi anggaplah ia sementara dan eksport satu sandaran.
dataDurabilityUnknown.description: en: This browser does not say whether stored data will be kept, so treat it as temporary and export a backup.

state.example: Best effort: the browser may clear this on its own if the device runs low on space. Export a backup.

optExportDesc.message: Menyimpan setiap baris tersimpan ke dalam satu fail JSON pada peranti ini. Tiada apa-apa dimuat naik.
optExportDesc.description: en: Saves every stored row to one JSON file on this device. Nothing is uploaded.

optDeleteAllDesc.message: Membuang setiap baris tersimpan daripada peranti ini. Tetapan dikekalkan.
optDeleteAllDesc.description: en: Removes every stored row from this device. Settings are kept.

optResetDesc.message: Mengembalikan setiap tetapan pada halaman ini kepada nilai lalai dan membuangnya daripada profil pelayar tersegerak anda. Baris tersimpan dikekalkan.
optResetDesc.description: en: Puts every setting on this page back to its default and removes them from your synced browser profile. Stored rows are kept.

optReportDesc.message: Membina fail kecil yang menerangkan keadaan sambungan ini. Anda nampak dengan tepat apa yang ada di dalamnya sebelum ia disimpan, dan tiada apa-apa dihantar ke mana-mana.
optReportDesc.description: en: Builds a small file describing this extension’s state. You see exactly what is in it before it is saved, and nothing is sent anywhere.

aboutBlurb.message: Satu ayat yang menyatakan dengan tepat apa yang dilakukan alat ini. Ia bekerja pada peranti anda: tiada akaun, tiada penjejakan, tiada panggilan rangkaian, tiada apa-apa dihantar kepada kami.
aboutBlurb.description: en: One sentence saying exactly what this tool does. It does its work on your device: no account, no tracking, no network calls, nothing sent to us.

toastDeleteFailed.description: en: Could not delete — try again

toastSaveFailed.description: en: Could not save that setting

toastExportFailed.description: en: Could not save the file

toastResetFailed.description: en: Could not reset the settings

confirmDeleteAllBody.message: Setiap baris tersimpan dibuang daripada peranti ini. Tetapan anda dikekalkan. Ini tidak boleh dibatalkan.
confirmDeleteAllBody.description: en: Every stored row is removed from this device. Your settings are kept. This cannot be undone.

confirmResetBody.message: Setiap keutamaan pada halaman ini kembali kepada nilai lalai dan dibuang daripada profil pelayar tersegerak anda. Baris tersimpan anda dikekalkan. Ini tidak boleh dibatalkan.
confirmResetBody.description: en: Every preference on this page goes back to its default and is removed from your synced browser profile. Your stored rows are kept. This cannot be undone.

confirmReportBody.message: Inilah segala isi fail itu nanti. Ia tidak mengandungi alamat halaman, teks halaman, mahupun apa-apa yang anda tangkap. Tiada apa-apa dihantar ke mana-mana — fail itu disimpan pada peranti ini dan anda yang menentukan sama ada mahu berkongsi.
confirmReportBody.description: en: This is everything the file will contain. It holds no page addresses, no page text and nothing you have captured. Nothing is sent anywhere — the file is saved on this device and it is yours to share or not.

popupPrivateNotSaved.message: Tetingkap peribadi — hasil ini tidak disimpan ke dalam sejarah anda.
popupPrivateNotSaved.description: en: Private window — this result was not saved to your history.

optSiteAccessDesc.message: Hanya perlu untuk ciri yang berfungsi pada halaman yang anda tidak klik butang bar alatnya. Anda boleh menariknya balik pada bila-bila masa, di sini.
optSiteAccessDesc.description: en: Only needed for the features that work on pages you have not clicked the toolbar button on. You can take it back at any time, here.

siteAccessGranted.message: Buat masa ini sambungan ini boleh membaca setiap tapak yang anda lawati.
siteAccessGranted.description: en: This extension can currently read every site you visit.

siteAccessNotGranted.message: Sambungan ini hanya boleh membaca tab selepas anda klik butangnya pada bar alat.
siteAccessNotGranted.description: en: This extension can only read a tab after you click its toolbar button.

toastSiteAccessRevokeFailed.message: Tidak dapat menarik balik akses itu
toastSiteAccessRevokeFailed.description: en: Could not revoke that access
